title: 1,106 pass electronics engineers licensure exam; CIT-U grad tops list
summary: A graduate of Cebu Institute of Technology-University (CIT-U) topped the licensure examination for electronics engineers held on October 17 and 18, the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC)…

blocks.text: A graduate of Cebu Institute of Technology–University (CIT-U) topped the licensure examination for electronics engineers held this month, the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced Friday.
CIT-U's Rohan Ardiente ranked first with a rating of 95.80%, followed by Peterson Torio of Bulacan State University–Malolos, who scored 95.20%.
Justin Tria of the University of the Philippines Diliman placed third with 94.90%.

Vin Diesel Alduheza of Mapua University–Manila and Patrick Angelo Montenegro of Batangas State University–Alangilan tied for fourth place with 94.80%, while Jethroe Gatbunton of De La Salle University–Dasmariñas ranked fifth with 94.60%.
The exam had 1,106 passers out of 2,337 examinees.

The PRC also released on Friday the results of the October 2026 electronics technician licensure examination, with Hasnor Pithailan Noor of Bulacan State University–Malolos topping the list of passers.
A total of 1,804 out of 2,054 examinees passed. — VBL, GMA News
